leftovers.park.describe.prune: Pruning parked snapshots nobody is waiting on
leftovers.park_note.usage: usage: /park-note [--token <token>] <message> — send a directive to a parked agent, delivered when it resumes (without --token: the most recently parked agent of this session)
leftovers.park_note.unknown_flag: /park-note: unknown flag %s — the only flag is --token <token>; to send a message that begins with dashes, put -- before it
leftovers.park_note.queued: noted for parked agent %s, delivered when it resumes — /resume %s to wake it now
complete.leftovers.park_note.token: send the note to this park instead of the most recent one: --token <token> <message>
